remarks: Say hello to 33 Seaview Ave, Unit 1B-a stunning sun-filled 1-bedroom apartment that delivers space, style, and privacy right in the heart of East Norwalk.  Wake up to sunshine in your very own private sunroom porch looking out to the Long Island Sound. Perfect for morning coffee, a home office/reading space, or simply soaking in the coastal vibe. Inside, the updated kitchen with sleek cabinetry and gas cooking sets the stage for great meals, while the oversized living room and full dining room make entertaining effortless.  The king-sized bedroom offers plenty of space plus oversized closets, giving you the comfort and storage you've been searching for. All of this and with reserved parking, basement storage, and pet-friendly options, convenience is built right in.  Just steps from Veterans Memorial Park, the East Norwalk train station, great restaurants, and buzzing nightlife.  This isn't just an apartment-it's your new lifestyle. Welcome home to Unit 1B.
